releases.title: Write while it plays
notes: The keys write chords into a pattern while it plays; hold EDIT and turn SELECT to move a chord.
Each pattern has its own mutes, and you can switch to the song while it plays.
The crash rings like metal, and a dimmed KEY or SCALE tells you why.

releases.title: REC records straight into the sequencer
notes: REC on the main screen records your chords into a new sequencer pattern; the looper is gone.
A loop you saved becomes a pattern the next time you switch on.
Your drum hits, the beats and the playing step light up on the keys.

releases.title: Patterns in the backup
notes: A backup now holds the sequencer's patterns and song, with your sounds, settings and loop.
Restore brings the patterns back. Backups made with 0.3 don't have them.
After an install, the page says where to make a backup.

releases.title: A sequencer for chords, bass and drums
notes: A sequencer: eight patterns and a song, each pattern with Chords, Bass, Layer and Drums tracks.
Eleven drums in eight kits you can mix, each drum with its own level.
An arpeggio or a strum can play a track, and single notes glide too.

releases.title: Whole chords strike again
notes: RETRIG has a new setting, Chord: the whole chord starts again, gliding from the last one.
Glide on VA sounds now takes the time you set.
The Lock layouts show a padlock in the top bar.

releases.title: The first release
notes: The lower keys play the notes of your scale; hold an upper key, and each note becomes a chord.
A bass part, an arpeggiator with a strum, a looper and about 60 VA and FM sounds.
A flower (Top layout) or a coral (Side layout) grows from every chord.
